versions.how: uploaded by the release workflow (tools/modpack_publish.sh) once the repository variable MODRINTH_PACK_PROJECT_ID is set; one normal and one hard version per Minecraft version (0.9.0+26.2, 0.9.0-hard+26.2...)

gallery.title: The Unfinished
gallery.description: The boss of World 10, the Giant Workshop, fought on its lacquered stage. Every attack is announced, struck, then leaves an opening.

gallery.title: The Giant Workshop
gallery.description: World 10's creatures, the last world before the smallest doll: a synthesis of the nine rules before it.

gallery.title: The Light Eater
gallery.description: Boss of World 5, the Lightless Deep, where noise is the rule. The pack leaves out dynamic lights so the dark stays dark.

gallery.title: World 2, Giant Veins
gallery.description: Heat is the rule here. Each of the ten worlds has its own creatures, station, structures and boss.

gallery.title: The souls bar
gallery.description: Your souls have their own bar above the experience bar, and the world's gauge sits with your hearts. Entering a world shows its name and rule. All of it is in Options > Matriochka....

gallery.title: The Artisan's Journal
gallery.description: Objective, quests, karma, worlds, the Scroll and the pages you found, in one book.

gallery.title: The Nesting Cradle
gallery.description: The ten world ores set in the Cradle, and the ritual of ten nesting dolls that turns them into Matriochkite.

gallery.title: The Matriarch Armour
gallery.description: Forged from Matriochkite, the metal of the ten worlds, with its Nested Shell.
